title: PowerShell encoded-command switch
rationale: An encoded command can conceal script content; recover and inspect the command and process context.
false_positives: Legitimate deployment or management scripts using encoded commands
limitations: Simple substring matching; aliases, abbreviations and whitespace variants can evade detection
Requires Sysmon process creation with CommandLine and Image
Encoding alone does not prove malicious intent

title: PowerShell execution-policy bypass switch
rationale: Review policy-bypass execution in its user and parent-process context.
limitations: Bypass is not inherently malicious and execution policy is not a security boundary
Simple command-line variants only

title: Certutil file decoding
rationale: Decoding can stage a payload; inspect input/output artifacts and subsequent execution.
limitations: Decode intent is not a malware verdict
Does not verify output file content
Simple command-line matching

title: Mshta with a remote URL or inline script
rationale: Review script execution through mshta, destination context and follow-on processes.
false_positives: Legacy HTA applications and internal administration
limitations: Local HTA payloads without these strings are not covered
Does not establish successful network access

title: New scheduled task containing a script interpreter
rationale: Inspect task XML, trigger, principal, executable and author; verify the task's purpose.
limitations: Security 4698 requires appropriate auditing
TaskContent may be absent
Keywords can appear in descriptions and arguments
Non-script task persistence is not covered

title: Run-key value set to a script interpreter
rationale: A script interpreter in a logon autorun value warrants artifact and author verification.
limitations: Run-key path matching is narrow
Executable-only autoruns are not covered
Value set does not prove execution or attacker ownership

title: Windows Security audit log cleared
rationale: Verify the operator and reason for clearing the audit log and preserve remaining evidence.
limitations: Clearing alone does not establish malicious intent
Does not cover deletion of other logs or missing events

title: Schtasks creation targeting a script interpreter
rationale: Review the task-creation command, process ancestry and resulting task artifact; a command alone does not prove task creation succeeded.
limitations: Requires Sysmon 1, Image and CommandLine
Keywords may occur in task names or arguments
Does not cover task creation through APIs or COM
Does not establish successful task registration or execution
